value: No unsolicited contact regarding individual with outstanding unexecuted arrest warrant (unless existing bond on individual)
No in-person or telephone solicitation between 9 p.m. and 9 a.m.
No in-person or telephone solicitation within 24 hours of arrest warrant execution or warrantless arrest
No solicitation in a police station, jail, prison, detention facility, or other place of detainment
solicitation_restrictions.quote: a bail bond surety, an agent of a corporate surety, or an employee of the surety or agent may not make, cause to be made, or benefit from unsolicited contact ... A bail bond surety or an agent of a bail bond surety may not solicit bonding business in a police station, jail, prison, detention facility, or other place of detainment for persons in the custody of law enforcement.

attorney_referral_prohibited.quote: A bail bond surety or an agent of a bail bond surety may not recommend or suggest to a person for whom the bail bond surety executes a bond the employment of an attorney or law firm in connection with a criminal offense.

rebate_and_kickback_prohibition.quote: A person in the bonding business may not directly or indirectly give, donate, lend, or contribute, or promise to give, donate, lend, or contribute, money or property to an attorney, police officer, sheriff, deputy, constable, jailer, or employee of a law enforcement agency for the referral of bonding business.

surrender_of_principal_rules.quote: A person executing a bail bond may surrender the principal for whom the bond is executed by: (1) if the principal is represented by an attorney, notifying the principal's attorney of the person's intention to surrender the principal ... and (2) filing an affidavit with the court or magistrate before which the prosecution is pending

security_deposit_required_for_company.quote: deposit with the county treasurer a cashier's check, certificate of deposit, or cash in the amount stated on the application under Section 1704.154(b)(2)(E);

security_deposit_minimum_amount.quote: A deposit made under Subsection (a)(1)(A) or (a)(2) may not be less than $50,000.

unpaid_forfeiture_judgment_limit.quote: A corporation may not act as a bail bond surety in a county in which the corporation is in default on five or more bail bonds.

bond_register_required.quote: A license holder shall maintain: (1) a record of each bail bond executed by the license holder; and (2) a separate set of records for each county in which the license holder is licensed.

record_retention_period_years.quote: maintained for not less than four years after the conclusion of the case for which the bond was given.
